observations: A complete authoritative base plus explicit recovery records can be repaired safely when the new sequence assignment is precomputed, the entire JSON document is validated, and mutation is one expected-blob CAS followed by exact remote readback.

Only exact sequence-and-content replay is safely idempotent; a revision conflict, malformed source, duplicate ID with different content, or readback mismatch must fail closed without a second mutation.

retained_learning: For append-only authoritative control files, bind intent to both expected revision and expected blob before constructing the complete next document.
Validate the current JSON/schema and every proposed invariant before mutation; never use a partial textual append for a structured authority file.
Attempt one CAS only. A CAS conflict is new information and requires a fresh semantic boundary, not an automatic mutation retry.
Require bounded exact serialized-content and blob-SHA readback after the CAS, and record mutation and readback as distinct effect states.
Accept idempotent replay only when the already-present assigned sequences and contents exactly match the requested entries.
